msg_001.author: aisha.rahman@steward-demo.co.uk
msg_001.content: The Jura coffee machine has stopped making drinks and the screen says ‘grinder jammed’. I have attached a photo from the kitchen counter. Can someone help before the stand-up?
msg_001.photo_description: Photo of the office kitchen coffee machines; the reported Jura X8 is on the counter.

msg_002.author: leo.martin@steward-demo.co.uk
msg_002.content:
Subject: Dishwasher error E24

The dishwasher stopped after the breakfast dishes. It is showing E24 and there is water at the bottom. I have left it switched off and attached a photo.

Thanks,
Leo
msg_002.photo_description: Photo of an open, loaded dishwasher. The reported error code is E24.

msg_003.author: sam.clarke@steward-demo.co.uk
msg_003.content: Kitchen sockets are out: the coffee machine and counter outlets have no power. I took a photo of the fuse board; one breaker looks down. No smoke, heat, water or burning smell.
msg_003.photo_description: Close-up of a consumer unit / circuit breaker panel. Treat the message safety details and office asset record as authoritative for the labelled Kitchen Sockets breaker.

msg_004.author: nikolaj.jensen@steward-demo.co.uk
msg_004.content: The reception printer has a paper jam in tray 2. I removed the loose sheet but the error remains, so I have not forced anything. Photo attached.
msg_004.photo_description: Photo of a printer with its internal paper path exposed for maintenance; do not ask staff to dismantle the office printer.

msg_005.author: leo.martin@steward-demo.co.uk
msg_005.location: Open-plan desks, zone C near desk C10
msg_005.content:
Subject: Plants by C10

The planter next to desk C10 has dry soil and several yellowing, damaged leaves. I have attached a photo. Could it be watered today and added to the next plant-care visit?

Leo
msg_005.photo_description: Close-up of severely damaged, yellowing plant leaves.
